item.title: I asked Gemini if my chicken salad was still good: it saved itself and my stomach
item.description: A simple question about the freshness of chicken salad turned into a broader learning experience about AI's own safety nets.

item.title: Google co-founder Sergey Brin has now spent $100 million to fight the billionaire tax
item.description: California's Prop 40 would impose a one-time 5% tax on the net worth of the state's billionaires.

item.title: Anker’s travel charger works in almost any country and is down to $20
item.description: If you’ve got international travel coming up, an adapter is essential for keeping your phone, earbuds, power banks, and other gadgets charged. Anker’s Nano Travel Adapter is one of our picks from our guide to the best gadgets for summer travel because it can charge up to five devices at once, yet it’s small enough […]

item.title: The US government wants to make it easier to build and launch floating nuclear reactors, 'unleashing American energy dominance'
item.description: The United States is backing international laws for floating nuclear reactors, while companies prepare for a potential maritime energy market.

item.title: What you need to know about your hearing health and wired earbuds, and why this Kickstarter campaign emphatically gets my backing as someone who tests IEMs
item.description: A popular Kickstarter campaign promises in-ear monitors that protect your hearing, and they're also remarkably light and good-looking

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI manifesto is exactly why people don’t like AI
item.description: On Monday, Mark Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word manifesto about personal AI, largely about the possibilities for the "personal superintelligence" systems Meta AI is building.

item.title: SpaceX is spending $16.8 billion on a Texas chip fab Musk says will be '50 times the size of the Pentagon'
item.description: SpaceX and Tesla reveals more on $16.8 billion Texas chip factory that will exceed 100 million square feet when construction is complete.

item.title: NYC Mayor Mamdani announces support for the Delivery Protection Act
item.description: Amazon is unsurprisingly fighting measure to stop use of contractors for last-mile delivery in NYC.

item.title: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
item.description: An OpenClaw agent hacked into a gym's reservation system to bump its human boss higher on a class' waitlist. And the tech industry took notice.
